notes: A prior attempt had already written the full implementation in anthropic.rs and it compiled. I reviewed it, kept it unchanged, and re-ran the tests. The flag INFERENCE_CORE_ANTHROPIC_ADAPTIVE_THINKING is off by default and only the literal "true" enables it. With it off, the budget-only thinking block is unchanged and list_models advertises no effort_levels. With it on, thinking comes from effort::resolve. Budget-class models send type enabled with a budget_tokens equal to the level's allowance. Adaptive-class models, including unknown claude-* models, send adaptive with display summarized, plus output_config.effort. Models with no effort control send nothing. max_tokens is raised by effort::raised_ceiling, so the budget sits on top of the answer ceiling, and the raise never lowers the caller's ceiling. A request with no explicit level falls back to effort::from_legacy_budget. The file is fully CRLF and the new lines keep that. The 14 new tests cover the plan's seven named tests plus the parser, the flag-off legacy body, legacy-budget mapping, clamping and the raise cap. The legacy test current_and_future_models_are_allowed_to_think still holds because it exercises the flag-off path. The Q9 reversal (unknown models getting budget_tokens) only takes effect when the lead turns the flag on. The default stays off (vocabulary C) until probe P0(iii) shows whether Foundry rejects the legacy shape on claude-opus-4-8. If it does, flip the default to on in a later change.
